# Thinking orbs engine

Source: https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev/tree/bfcb86329da15235a5ee2dcdb6417c8a80f82bb1/packages/thinking-orbs

Version: 0.3.2. License: MIT, copyright 2026 Jakub Antalik.

The engine and presets are copied without geometry changes. The local types file keeps only the geometry types and excludes React. The unused engine export entry point is omitted. The native DOM wrapper lives in ../../activity-orb.ts. No React dependency is used.
